                        PAGINATE DOCUMENT

                                       YOUR     POSSIBLE
  ID  ITEM                             CHOICE   CHOICES

  a   Paginate From Page               1        1 - 5

  b   Paginate on Exact Line Count     2        1 = Yes    2 = No

  c   Adjust Line Endings              1        1 = Yes    2 = No

  d   Adjust Page Endings              1        1 = Yes    2 = No
